title: Closing Margin Schedule for Home Purchase Financing Sale Paydowns
content:
**Closing margin schedule — Home Purchase Financing sale paydowns**

Where the closing date is more than 21 days after the paydown date, the closing margin is 200.00; where it is 8 to 21 days after, the closing margin is 100.00. Where the closing is 7 days or fewer after the paydown date, this schedule sets no closing margin.

The closing date is the one on the borrower's resale file under contract; the days are calendar days from the paydown date to the closing date.

| Calendar days from the paydown date to the closing date | Closing margin (USD) |
|---|---|
| more than 21 | 200.00 |
| 8 to 21 | 100.00 |
| 7 or fewer | not set by this schedule |

### Boundary cases (hypothetical paydown date 2026-05-04)

| Closing date | Days after the paydown date | Closing margin |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-05-26 | 22 | 200.00 |
| 2026-05-25 | 21 | 100.00 |
| 2026-05-12 | 8 | 100.00 |
| 2026-05-11 | 7 | none |
